# pmax — Performance marketing agency, Mallorca

> pmax (PMax Online S.L.) is a performance marketing agency based in Calvià, Mallorca, Spain. We run Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, SEO, and AI search visibility programmes for European brands. Flat monthly retainer fees — no percentage of media spend, no conflicting incentives. Clients typically spend €5,000–€200,000/month on media. 93% twelve-month client retention. Multilingual: campaigns in up to 19 languages, site in EN/DE/ES.

## Services

- [AI Search Visibility (GEO)](https://pmax.online/services/ai-visibility/): How to get your brand cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews — entity graph, structured data, citation-worthy content.
- [Google Ads & Performance Max](https://pmax.online/services/google-ads/): Search, Shopping, PMax and YouTube — built from the signal up. Feed optimisation, Smart Bidding, CRM-fed offline conversions.
- [Paid Social](https://pmax.online/services/paid-social/): Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn — CAPI and Events API connected, creative-led, measured against revenue not impressions.
- [SEO](https://pmax.online/services/seo/): Technical SEO, content strategy, regional and multilingual SEO. Rankings that compound into AI citations.
- [Conversion Design (CRO)](https://pmax.online/services/conversion-design/): More revenue from the same traffic — A/B testing, landing page rebuilds, funnel design.
- [Analytics & Tracking](https://pmax.online/services/analytics/): Server-side GTM, Consent Mode v2, GA4, offline conversion imports. The measurement layer everything else stands on.
- [Creative Production](https://pmax.online/services/creative/): Static, motion and UGC video on a weekly cadence — briefed by media data, built for testing.

- [Luxaflex dealer network](https://pmax.online/cases/luxaflex/): +184% showroom visits across 60+ franchisees — multi-location performance marketing at scale.
- [LEDXpress e-commerce](https://pmax.online/cases/ledxpress/): +365% monthly revenue in 8 months through SEO — pulled off the paid-ads treadmill.
- [IMERO SaaS](https://pmax.online/cases/imero/): −60% CPC, +307% sign-ups via Google Ads rebuild across 11 languages for a regulated SaaS.
- [PRIMUNDUS healthcare](https://pmax.online/cases/primundus/): 4.2x qualified care enquiries via regional SEO for a German 24-hour care provider.
- [Gabiona e-commerce](https://pmax.online/cases/gabionas/): +41% AOV, 6.8x ROAS from margin-aware Google Shopping rebuild across 5 European markets.
- [Unisono Luxury Homes](https://pmax.online/cases/unisono/): +183% phone leads, +138% CTR — multi-channel programme for an independent luxury villa brand in Mallorca.
- [B2B energy utility](https://pmax.online/cases/energy-utility/): 5.2x more sales-qualified leads from organic search for a listed German energy company.
- [PREO Software AG](https://pmax.online/cases/preo/): 3.1x branded search volume in 12 months via content-led B2B SEO.
- [VC investor](https://pmax.online/cases/vc-investor/): +312% qualified event sign-ups, −41% cost per registration via LinkedIn Ads.
- [Auto manufacturer](https://pmax.online/cases/automotive/): +38% purchase intent lift via Meta brand campaign with brand-lift study methodology.

## How we work

- Flat monthly retainer — client pays media directly to platforms; pmax never handles budgets
- Multilingual: campaigns in up to 19 languages; site and support in EN, DE, ES
- Server-side tracking, Consent Mode v2, GDPR and LOPDGDD compliant by default
- 93% twelve-month client retention
- First conversation: 30 minutes, free, no pitch
